name: Berry Mule (Alcoholic)
ingredients:
4 oz Zevia Ginger Beer Mixer
1 Can of Zevia Cran-Raspberry4 oz vodka
2 oz cranberry juice
2 limes juiced (about 2 tablespoons) (2 true lime packets)
Garnish: fresh berries and mint berries for garnish
instructions:
Place crushed ice into two chilled mule mugs.
Pour 2 oz. Zevia Ginger beer, 2 oz. Vodka, 1 oz. Cranberry juice, 1 tbsp. Lime juice and ½ Can of Zevia Cran-Raspberry into each mule mug.
Stir to combine.
Garnish with berries and mint. Serve immediately.
